blocks.text: Why a Chauffeur Makes Sense in Newport Beach
Three practical reasons, specific to this city.
blocks.html: Three practical reasons, specific to this city.

items: The Balboa Peninsula has no through-streets and effectively no parking, so wedding shuttles are the standard rather than the exception.
Newport Beach's venues are physically split across Corona del Mar, Balboa Island and Lido Isle, and guests cross bridges between them at peak hour.
Harbor parking and dock operations make vehicle staging awkward, which favors one coach running a pre-set loop.
SNA is about 12 miles away, but LAX serves most destination-wedding guest lists.

blocks.text: We also quote Newport Beach to the hour rather than the trip. Most groups need four hours, and four is the standard minimum across the industry because a committed vehicle cannot be sold to anyone else while it is parked at your venue. If your night genuinely needs less, ask for a one-way transfer rate instead of paying a full minimum.

blocks.text: Choosing a Vehicle for a Newport Beach Night

Capacity is the first filter, then cost per person. A stretch limo seats 6 to 8, a Chrysler 300 about 8, a Hummer 12, and a Sprinter limo up to 14. Our party bus seats 24. Below about ten people, two cars or a limo usually beats a bus. Above ten, the bus wins on cost per head and nobody gets left behind.

blocks.text: Licensed, Insured, and Backup Plans

Every chauffeur on our team is licensed and background checked, and our vehicles are licensed and inspected. Our drivers work the night and do not drink, which matters when the group includes teenagers, and we set a fixed return time off the venue's posted close so nobody is standing in a parking lot at 1 AM wondering where the car went.
